DARV.talk.SNAKE_IN_SPIRE_EXTEND_CHARACTE: Come pick somethin' out, ya wondrous little critter! Are ya here all by your lonesome today?
Ya don't like that eyeball? Can't blame ya, starin' at it'd make anyone woozy!
Ya got a collection of your own, huh! How 'bout we make a trade?
If it helps me defeat the Architect, I'll gladly trade.
Course! I'll pick ya out some fine gear right now!
NEOW.talk.SNAKE_IN_SPIRE_EXTEND_CHARACTE: He remains immeasurably powerful. Grant your blessing.
NONUPEIPE.talk.SNAKE_IN_SPIRE_EXTEND_CHA: Among the Spire's creatures, you are a clean one. Come closer, and let me make you resplendent.
I have seen the creatures you bless. One of them attacked me.
You ought to count yourself fortunate that you encountered my guard rather than something else, ought you not?
Great and loyal knight! I shall bestow my blessing upon you.
A puppet from beyond, and yet you do not sing my name.
Hope I won't have to. [i][font_size=22]If you saw "her name", please report to mod author.[/font_size][/i]
OROBAS.talk.SNAKE_IN_SPIRE_EXTEND_CHARAC: Things from here! Things not here before!!
...You know what these are, yet still waiting for me?
Architect can help you! More shiny gifts!!
PAEL.talk.SNAKE_IN_SPIRE_EXTEND_CHARACTE: Your father lives. I fear our cycle is in vain.
[thinky_dots]It is not my place to persuade you... take a part of me.[/thinky_dots]
[i][font_size=22]The Snake chooses not to wake Pael.[/font_size][/i]
[thinky_dots]You should let go of your obsession.[/thinky_dots]
So you tried to persuade me anyway. What will you write this time?
[thinky_dots]There is no need. What I carve melts away soon enough, and Father never reads it...[/thinky_dots]
TANX.talk.SNAKE_IN_SPIRE_EXTEND_CHARACTE: [b]SUCH A MIGHTY WEAPON! BUT YOU ARE TOO SMALL, HOW CAN YOU USE IT![/b]
[b]YOU BRING TOO MANY NOT-WEAPONS! TAKE OFF THAT CLOTH AND FIGHT AGAIN!![/b]
[b]THESE ARE ALL WEAPONS!? THEN YOU SURELY NEED MORE!![/b]
TEZCATARA.talk.SNAKE_IN_SPIRE_EXTEND_CHA: Do come in, quiet little one! Seeing you again so soon, you must be exhausted.
Thank for your concern. You've mistaken.
Oh dearie me, come warm up! You're nearly frozen stiff out there.
So persistent, you cute little thing! Let me help you again this time, shall I?
VAKUU.talk.SNAKE_IN_SPIRE_EXTEND_CHARACT: I need only the power to strike the Architect. Please do not misunderstand.
You even remember all of it willingly! [i][font_size=22]Vakuu howls with laughter.[/font_size][/i]
The Architect is not enough, kill that wraith too!
Sign this one as well. I prepared it specially for you — you meet every requirement to become my puppet.
I did not come for you. And there is nothing written on it, is there?
Must you ruthlessly see through even my friendly jests? You grow more endearing by the moment.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SNAKE_IN_SPIRE_EXTEND: There is someone who desires you more than I do.
Neither of us needs to feign ignorance.
Neow's doing, was it? Killing her serves your purpose.
That lunatic will come for you again, without return. So will I.
